caption: The worked example with k = 0.04: the window sums 16, 16 and 0 give H = [[16,0],[0,16]], so both eigenvalues are 16, det H = 256 and trace H = 32. Then R = 256 − 0.04 × 32² = 215.04, large and positive, so the point is a corner.

spec.title: Harris on a 2×2 window

nodes.label: Window sums
nodes.note: Σ Ix² = Σ Iy² = 16, Σ IxIy = 0

spec.aria: Worked example flow: gradient products summed over the window give 16, 16 and 0, which build H = [[16,0],[0,16]] with eigenvalues 16 and 16, then det H = 256 and trace H = 32 give R = 215.04, a large positive response meaning the point is a corner.
